verdict.rationale: Netlify's own site says you can "drop your project folder and deploy in seconds" and that "new projects stay private until you choose to publish" (netlify-docs-4), which matches the story almost word for word. The CLI also deploys straight from a local working directory with no Git repo (netlify-docs-2, netlify-docs-3, netlify-docs-15). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the private-until-publish state and the publish step work, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the folder-upload, Git-free flow.
